snippet.title: Veil of Ashes | RTT-Game | Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
Veil of Ashes is a dynamic real-time tactic game designed to quickly throw you into the heat of battle using customised armies and your own playstyle.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3511540?utm_source=YouTube&utm_medium=organic
Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/JrNYJ8Qsww
https://greifenmaer.com/veil-of-ashes
https://www.instagram.com/veilofashesgame
https://www.tiktok.com/@veilofashesgame

Veil of Ashes is set in a dark steampunk setting in an alternative 19th century.
Players use a battalion editor to create a customised deck of different units from the infantry, tank and land cruiser classes, allowing them to develop their own playstyle for the three factions.

We are a small indie developer studio from Germany and we are happy to share the trailer for our game Veil of Ashes with you!

We would be delighted if you could share your opinions and ideas about our game project, as this is the only way we can create a product that you will like!

Stay tuned, because there's more to come.
